description: This file defines the 'Location' controller class for the admin localisation namespace in OpenCart. It manages CRUD operations and listing of locations, including rendering forms, listing data, handling sorting and pagination, and interactions with the Location model. The class extends the base Controller class and contains methods for listing, adding, editing, and deleting location entities within the admin panel.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing localisation location entities in the OpenCart admin interface. Includes methods for displaying, listing, editing, and creating locations, with handling of form submissions, listing sorting, pagination, and data preparation for views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the location controller. Loads language, sets page title, prepares URL parameters for sorting/pagination, and renders the main location listing view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles Ajax request to send the location list HTML fragment by calling getList() and outputting the result.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches list of locations from the model with sorting and pagination, prepares data including breadcrumbs, sorting URLs, and passes it to the view for rendering the list.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a location, pre-populating fields if editing, or empty for creation. Handles form data and errors, and renders the form view.
